scope: Exercise the public AC1032 whole-file DXF writer with an INSERT-owned multiline ATTRIB and embedded MTEXT across every measured allocation failure, same-codec retry, and fresh typed readback.

source.profile: One INSERT with one ATTRIB (m_attributeType 2) carrying an embedded two-paragraph MTEXT payload, emitted as AC1032 ASCII and Binary. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Add a focused generated dx_iface that writes an INSERT and embedded multiline ATTRIB through dxfRW::write at AC1032. Calibrate each encoding, inject one-shot allocation failures at every observed offset, assert the preexisting destination and caller graph remain unchanged, retry the same codec and require byte-identical output plus typed callback readback.

validation.focusedCTest: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^libdxfrw_dxf_r2018_embedded_attribute_allocation_transaction$' --output-on-failure: PASS 1/1 (0.49 sec); the existing whole-operation transaction selector also passes 1/1 (9.36 sec).
validation.asanCTest: ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R '^libdxfrw_dxf_r2018_embedded_attribute_allocation_transaction$' --output-on-failure: PASS 1/1 (4.14 sec). The initial combined old-plus-new ASan invocation exceeded its 60-second timeout; the profile was split into its own selector. The existing whole-operation selector was rechecked separately in normal mode; its ASan run is not included in this receipt.
validation.directRun: PASS; existing AC1027 whole-write profile: ASCII 1184 and Binary 1160 allocation offsets; new AC1032 embedded ATTRIB/MTEXT profile: ASCII 109 and Binary 108 offsets. Each failure preserved caller/destination state; same-codec retry matched calibrated output and fresh typed readback passed.

limitations: The generated profile does not qualify producer-authored AC1032 attribute variants, outer annotative metadata, or native attribute display.
No support claim is promoted and no drawing fixture is committed.
nextAction: Continue the P6-G public-writer inventory; retain separate gates for producer profile, semantic support, and native consumer behavior.
